CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_pending_receivals_from_purchase_order(p_issuance_id uuid, p_lines jsonb, p_actor text)
 RETURNS TABLE(pending_receival_id uuid, source_line_id uuid, source_line_number integer, creation_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$begin return query select * from public.create_allocated_po_receivals(p_issuance_id,p_lines,p_actor); end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_app_access()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, display_name text, role text, is_active boolean, read_only boolean, messaging_write boolean, production_blend_manage boolean, sample_labels_generate boolean, job_updates_post boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 select u.user_id,u.display_name,u.role,u.is_active,u.read_only,u.messaging_write,u.production_blend_manage,u.sample_labels_generate,u.job_updates_post
 from public.app_users u where u.user_id=auth.uid();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_tenops_business_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
 if auth.role() in ('anon','authenticated') or auth.uid() is not null then
   -- Preserve the original first-Admin bootstrap, whose RPC verifies the empty
   -- Admin state. Direct authenticated app_users writes remain ungranted.
   if tg_table_name='app_users' and auth.uid() is not null
     and not exists(select 1 from public.app_users where user_id=auth.uid())
     and not exists(select 1 from public.app_users where role='admin' and is_active) then return null; end if;
   perform public.require_app_capability('writeBusinessData');
 end if;
 return null;
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_app_capability(p_capability text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.app_users u where u.user_id=auth.uid() and u.is_active and
   case when p_capability='postJobUpdate' and u.job_updates_post and not u.read_only then true
        when p_capability='sample_labels.generate' then u.role='admin' or u.sample_labels_generate
        when p_capability='production_blend.manage' then u.role='admin' or u.production_blend_manage
        when u.read_only and p_capability='messaging.write' then u.messaging_write
        when u.read_only and p_capability not in ('readOperationalData','viewIntake','previewOperationalDocuments','accessDevelopmentEnvironment') then false
        else exists(select 1 from public.app_role_capabilities c where c.role=u.role and c.capability=p_capability) end);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_proposal_access()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from public.app_users u where u.user_id=auth.uid() and u.is_active and u.role='admin')
    or exists(select 1 from public.proposal_access_users g join public.app_users u on u.user_id=g.user_id where g.user_id=auth.uid() and u.is_active);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.po_base_create_pending_receivals(p_issuance_id uuid, p_lines jsonb, p_actor text)
 RETURNS TABLE(pending_receival_id uuid, source_line_id uuid, source_line_number integer, creation_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if coalesce(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' then
    perform public.require_app_capability('adjustInventory');
  end if;
  return query
  select *
  from public.tenops_create_pending_receivals_from_po_impl(p_issuance_id, p_lines, p_actor);
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.receive_pending_receival(p_receival_id uuid, p_received_by text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_receival public.pending_receivals%rowtype;
  v_existing_item_id bigint;
  v_vendor text;
begin
  select *
  into v_receival
  from public.pending_receivals
  where id = p_receival_id
    and status = 'pending'
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Pending receival was not found or has already been received.';
  end if;

  v_vendor := coalesce(nullif(trim(v_receival.vendor), ''), 'Unspecified');

  -- Reserved receivals must become their own inventory lot.
  -- Otherwise the reservation would tag the entire existing stock row.
  if coalesce(v_receival.is_earmarked, false) then
    insert into public.inventory_items (
      vendor,
      color,
      size,
      category,
      quantity,
      unit,
      location,
      pallet_number,
      notes,
      earmarked_for_job,
      earmarked_job,
      earmark_notes,
      updated_at,
      last_counted_at
    )
    values (
      nullif(v_receival.vendor, ''),
      v_receival.material_name,
      nullif(v_receival.size, ''),
      nullif(v_receival.category, ''),
      v_receival.quantity_expected,
      coalesce(nullif(v_receival.unit, ''), 'Bags'),
      coalesce(nullif(v_receival.location, ''), 'Denton'),
      nullif(v_receival.pallet_number, ''),
      v_receival.notes,
      true,
      nullif(v_receival.earmarked_job_name, ''),
      nullif(v_receival.earmark_notes, ''),
      now(),
      now()
    );
  else
    select id
    into v_existing_item_id
    from public.inventory_items
    where lower(coalesce(color, '')) = lower(coalesce(v_receival.material_name, ''))
      and lower(coalesce(size, '')) = lower(coalesce(v_receival.size, ''))
      and lower(coalesce(unit, '')) = lower(coalesce(v_receival.unit, ''))
      and coalesce(earmarked_for_job, false) = false
      and (
        v_receival.vendor is null
        or trim(v_receival.vendor) = ''
        or vendor is null
        or trim(vendor) = ''
        or lower(vendor) = lower(v_receival.vendor)
      )
    order by updated_at desc nulls last, id desc
    limit 1
    for update;

    if v_existing_item_id is not null then
      update public.inventory_items
      set
        quantity = coalesce(quantity, 0) + v_receival.quantity_expected,
        updated_at = now(),
        last_counted_at = now()
      where id = v_existing_item_id;
    else
      insert into public.inventory_items (
        vendor,
        color,
        size,
        category,
        quantity,
        unit,
        location,
        pallet_number,
        notes,
        earmarked_for_job,
        earmarked_job,
        earmark_notes,
        updated_at,
        last_counted_at
      )
      values (
        nullif(v_receival.vendor, ''),
        v_receival.material_name,
        nullif(v_receival.size, ''),
        nullif(v_receival.category, ''),
        v_receival.quantity_expected,
        coalesce(nullif(v_receival.unit, ''), 'Bags'),
        coalesce(nullif(v_receival.location, ''), 'Denton'),
        nullif(v_receival.pallet_number, ''),
        v_receival.notes,
        false,
        null,
        null,
        now(),
        now()
      );
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.inventory_transactions (
    transaction_type,
    vendor,
    item_name,
    size,
    unit,
    quantity,
    location,
    notes,
    catalog_source,
    is_earmarked,
    earmarked_job_name,
    earmark_notes
  )
  values (
    'intake',
    v_vendor,
    v_receival.material_name,
    nullif(v_receival.size, ''),
    coalesce(nullif(v_receival.unit, ''), 'Bags'),
    v_receival.quantity_expected,
    coalesce(nullif(v_receival.location, ''), 'Denton'),
    concat_ws(' ',
      'Received from pending receival.',
      nullif(v_receival.notes, '')
    ),
    'standard',
    coalesce(v_receival.is_earmarked, false),
    nullif(v_receival.earmarked_job_name, ''),
    nullif(v_receival.earmark_notes, '')
  );

  update public.pending_receivals
  set
    status = 'received',
    quantity_received = quantity_expected,
    received_by = p_received_by,
    received_at = now()
  where id = p_receival_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.receiving_import_delete_eligibility()
 RETURNS TABLE(document_id uuid, can_delete boolean, reason text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select d.id,
    case
      when d.uploaded_by_user_id<>auth.uid() then false
      when d.status in ('review','processing','needs_review','ready_to_confirm','failed','deleting') then true
      when d.status='confirmed'
        and not exists(select 1 from public.pending_receivals p where p.source_receiving_document_id=d.id and p.status<>'cancelled')
        and not exists(select 1 from public.pending_receivals p where p.source_receiving_document_id=d.id and (p.received_at is not null or p.receipt_inventory_item_id is not null or p.receipt_transaction_id is not null))
        and not exists(select 1 from public.inventory_transactions t join public.pending_receivals p on p.id=t.pending_receival_id where p.source_receiving_document_id=d.id)
        then true
      else false
    end,
    case
      when d.uploaded_by_user_id<>auth.uid() then 'Only the uploader may delete this Receiving Import.'
      when d.status in ('review','processing','needs_review','ready_to_confirm','failed','deleting') then null
      when exists(select 1 from public.pending_receivals p where p.source_receiving_document_id=d.id and (p.received_at is not null or p.receipt_inventory_item_id is not null or p.receipt_transaction_id is not null))
        or exists(select 1 from public.inventory_transactions t join public.pending_receivals p on p.id=t.pending_receival_id where p.source_receiving_document_id=d.id)
        then 'Cannot delete an import with received inventory history.'
      when exists(select 1 from public.pending_receivals p where p.source_receiving_document_id=d.id and p.status<>'cancelled')
        then 'Cancel its active Pending Receivals before deleting this import.'
      when d.status='confirmed' then null
      else 'This Receiving Import cannot be deleted in its current state.'
    end
  from public.receiving_documents d
  where public.has_app_capability('adjustInventory');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_app_capability(p_capability text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_app_capability(p_capability) then
    raise exception 'TenOps permission denied.' using errcode = '42501', detail = p_capability;
  end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_purchasing_catalog_item_v2(p_item jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare item_id uuid; selected_type text:=nullif(btrim(p_item->>'material_type'),''); selected_category text;
begin
  if selected_type not in ('chip','resin','pigment','filler','other') then
    raise exception 'Catalog material type must be a supported Purchase Order material classification.' using errcode='22023';
  end if;
  selected_category:=case selected_type
    when 'chip' then 'Chip / Aggregate'
    when 'resin' then 'Resin'
    when 'pigment' then 'Pigment'
    when 'filler' then 'Filler'
    else 'Other'
  end;
  item_id:=public.save_purchasing_catalog_item(p_item);
  update public.vendor_catalog_v2 set
    material_type=selected_type,
    category=coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_item->>'category'),''),selected_category),
    color=case when selected_type='resin' then nullif(btrim(p_item->>'color'),'') else null end,
    component_type=case when selected_type='resin' then nullif(btrim(p_item->>'component_type'),'') else null end,
    updated_at=now()
  where id=item_id;
  return item_id;
end;$function$
